## Setup
```{r}

library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)

df <- read_csv("esi_coefficients.csv")
df <- df |> rename(pft = 1, regions = 2, land_esi = 3, water_esi = 4, carbon_esi = 5) 

pft_levels  <- c("boreal","grass_c3","grass_c4","temperate","tropical","barren")
reg_levels  <- c("Asia","North America","Europe","Africa",
                 "South America","Oceania","Australia")

df <- df |>
  mutate(
    pft        = factor(pft, levels = pft_levels),
    regions    = factor(regions, levels = reg_levels)
  )

coulimpact <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFE5","#FFF7BC","#FEE391","#FEC44F",
                                 "#FE9929","#EC7014","#CC4C02","#993404"))(100)

# numbers format
sci_lab <- function(v)
  ifelse(is.na(v), "",
  ifelse(v == 0, "0",
  ifelse(abs(v) < 0.01, formatC(v, format = "e", digits = 1),   # scientific only if < 0.01
                        formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 2))))  # else plain 2-dp

carbon_val <- mean(df$carbon_esi) ## carbon_esi coefficient is the same across veg_types

bar_lab <- function(x) ifelse(x == 0, "0", formatC(x, format = "g", digits = 1)) # scientific notation for legend scale

```

## Build panels and combine them

```{r}
library(patchwork)

# each panel builds its OWN scale (own limits + own colourbar)
heat_map <- function(valcol, title) {
  vmax <- max(df[[valcol]], na.rm = TRUE)
  ggplot(df, aes(pft, regions, fill = .data[[valcol]])) +
    geom_tile(colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sci_lab(.data[[valcol]])), size = 2.4) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = coulimpact, limits = c(0, vmax), na.value = "white",
                         labels = bar_lab, name = NULL,
                         guide = guide_colourbar(barheight = unit(3, "cm"), barwidth = unit(0.35, "cm"),
                                                 ticks.colour = "black", frame.colour = NA)) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) + scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
    coord_equal() + labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5, size = 11, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "right")
}

p_c <- ggplot(tibble(x = "c", y = "c", value = carbon_val), aes(x, y, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3, fill= "#FFFFE5") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sci_lab(value)), size = 2.4) +
  coord_equal() + labs(title = expression(bold("Carbon ESI-A (per 1t of CO"[2]*"e / yr)")), x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5, size = 11, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none")

p_l <- heat_map("land_esi",  expression(bold("Land ESI  (per 1 km"^2*")")))
p_w <- heat_map("water_esi", expression(bold("Water ESI  (per 10"^3~"m"^3/yr*")")))

combined <- (p_c / p_l / p_w) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.5, 7, 8))

print(combined)
```

## Save figure
```{r}

ggsave("esi_combined_ownscales_updated.png", combined, width = 7, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
